posts.title: Dear Nicole
posts.description: Nicole, I am writing this into a quiet room without knowing whether you will ever open it or read it, which feels painfully appropriate for where we are now. posts.title: Twilight of the Idol
posts.description: Recognition has meaning only when it comes from a free, sovereign consciousness; the moment one degrades oneself to a beggar for grace, one ceases to be a partner and becomes a burden.

posts.title: The Infrastructure of Silence
posts.description: There is a strange, freezing freedom in writing into a space you know with absolute certainty the other person will never open. For a long time, I took it as a quiet grievance.
